states.code-integrated: a capability exists in kit/engine or kit/tools that a new project gets without hand work (the choice to use it is still made by hand or by Gemini)
states.code-project-only: implemented only inside the project copies mine/bomb_colorblind_v22 and mine/railroads_v2; a new Gemini project does NOT get it
states.prompt-only: the rule text reaches Gemini through PLAYBOOK.md (tools/gen_api.py code step) or FORMAT.md, but no render code implements it
states.documentation-only: only in docs or the learning log, not in any prompt (none left after the playbook update)
states.unimplemented: listed under unimplemented_capabilities: a part of a rule that no code, prompt or check covers

coverage.full: the whole rule is implemented as a capability

test_status.in_range: applied by hand in a real video and measured inside the reference range
test_status.partial: some measures in range, some not
test_status.failed: applied by hand and measured outside the reference range

how_to_read: No row has render_code_reads_rule = true: nothing in the renderer reads rules.json or beats.json. "Gemini consumes" means PLAYBOOK.md is part of the gen_api.py prompt (code step). The shot-planning step (tools/make_notes.py) does NOT receive the PLAYBOOK, only FORMAT.md, TEMPLATE.txt and one example. Whether Gemini obeys a rule in its output is untested.
